title: 2 Timothy Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 2 Timothy 2: the soldier, the athlete and the farmer, the trustworthy saying, Hymenaeus and Philetus, and the vessels in a large house.

questions.text: To what kind of men is Timothy to commit the things he has heard?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says to commit the things heard among many witnesses to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.

answers.text: To faithful men who can teach others
To learned men of the city of Rome
To the men who were his witnesses
To older men who keep the writings

questions.text: Like what is Timothy told to endure hardship?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says he must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

questions.text: When is someone who competes in athletics not crowned?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says that if anyone competes in athletics, he is not crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

questions.text: Who must be the first to get a share of the crops?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says the farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

questions.text: Of whose offspring is Jesus Christ said to be, in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says to remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David.

questions.text: What does the writer say about God's word, even though he suffers chains?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says he suffers hardship to the point of chains as a criminal, but God's word is not chained.

answers.text: It is hidden for a time

questions.text: According to the trustworthy saying, what happens if we endure?
questions.explanation: Verses 11 and 12 say that if we died with him we will also live with him, and if we endure we will also reign with him.

answers.text: We will be called his friends
We will receive a new name
We will rest from our labor
We will also reign with him

questions.text: What were Hymenaeus and Philetus saying?
questions.explanation: Verses 17 and 18 name Hymenaeus and Philetus as men who erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past.

answers.text: That the law is still binding
That the Lord had denied them

questions.text: Besides gold and silver, what are the vessels in a large house made of?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says that in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay.

questions.text: What does the text say the Lord's servant must not do?
questions.explanation: Verse 24 says the Lord's servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, and patient.
